spotify-api.$comment: All requests to the Spotify web-player API (spclient.wg.spotify.com).

spotify-read-all.$comment: Read anything from the Spotify web-player API (profile, playlists, library, etc.).

spotify-write-all.$comment: Create, update, or delete through the Spotify web-player API (e.g. create/edit/delete playlists, add/remove tracks).
